name: Gradaly v3.0.1
title: Gradaly v3.0.1
notes:
## What's New in Gradaly v3.0.1

- **Adjustable Interface & Grading Text Size (`90%` to `130%`)**: Customize the font size of the application (rubrics, criteria descriptions, AI justifications, student feedback, and student lists) directly in **Settings (⚙️)** or anytime via keyboard shortcuts (`Ctrl/Cmd +`, `Ctrl/Cmd -`, `Ctrl/Cmd + 0`).
- **Windows / Parallels Desktop Shared Folders Support**: Improved directory deletion and project renaming compatibility on network and virtualized drives (`\\Mac\Home\Documents`).
- **Unified Multi-Platform Application Icons**: Unified high-resolution Gradaly desktop icons across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
